programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for x in row:
            counts[x] = counts.get(x, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    r_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    r_tiles = [(r_bounds[i] + 1, r_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1)]
    c_tiles = [(c_bounds[i] + 1, c_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(c_bounds)-1)]
    sr0, sr1 = r_tiles[-1]
    sc0, sc1 = c_tiles[-1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in r_tiles:
        for c0, c1 in c_tiles:
            for dr in range(min(sr1-sr0, r1-r0)):
                for dc in range(min(sc1-sc0, c1-c0)):
                    value = grid[sr0+dr][sc0+dc]
                    if value != background:
                        out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = value
    return out
'''
